result.title: Demystifying the Autoresearch Harness: How Context and Skills Shape Self-Evolving Agents
result.summary: Autoresearch agents, which autonomously design, run, and refine experiments, are accelerating scientific progress, particularly in AI research. However, existing agents rely on harnesses that combine multiple mechanisms, making it difficult to determine how individual components contribute to performance. We systematically study harness design for long-horizon, self-evolving autoresearch agents along two dimensions: context management, which determines what an agent retains from its past attempts, and skill management, which governs how it stores and reuses lessons from those attempts. Across MLE-Bench and KernelBench with gpt-oss-120b, gpt-6-luna, and gpt-6-sol, we isolate the effects of individual harness design choices by evaluating each against a recency-truncation baseline within a shared agent framework. For context management, we find that preserving individually accessible records of past attempts is more effective than maintaining a rolling summary, with context folding performing best across all six settings and improving upon the baseline by up to 19.2%. For skill management, selectively discarding persistently unused lessons is more effective on average than consolidating them or promoting them to standing rules. Building on these findings, we combine context folding and skill deletion in MLEvolver, which achieves a 72.7% medal rate on MLE-Bench Lite and a 94% $\mathrm{fast}_1$ score on KernelBench Level 3, substantially outperforming AIDE and OpenEvolve under the same inference budget. Overall, our study distills design principles for preserving experimental history and curating reusable lessons in autoresearch harnesses, paving the way for agents that turn accumulated experience into sustained progress.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文系统拆解 autoresearch agent 的 harness 设计，比较不同上下文管理方式（保留可单独访问的历史尝试记录 vs 滚动摘要 vs context folding）与技能管理方式（合并、提升为常驻规则 vs 删除长期未用条目），并在 MLE-Bench、KernelBench 上隔离各组件的影响，最终组合出 MLEvolver。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「保留细粒度可访问记录优于摘要压缩」「丢弃长期未用经验」的结论，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、推理状态压缩与冗余历史清理提供概念参照，但与 latent 视觉推理无直接机制联系，需核查其抽象层次能否迁移。
